content.text:
`microsToUsd2dp` is used in four files outside its own definition file (`web/src/lib/redis/micro-dollars.ts`). I found them with a text search, and the graph query gave the same set.

- **`web/src/lib/admin/admin-shape.ts`** calls it three times, to build `costAllTime2dp`, `cost2dp` and `totalSpend2dp`.
- **`web/src/lib/leaderboard/assemble-board.ts`** calls it once, to convert a cost score to dollars.
- **`web/src/lib/leaderboard/window-sums-batch.ts`** calls it once, to build `cost2dp`.
- **`web/test/leaderboard/micro-dollars.test.ts`** is the test file, and it tests rounding at the cent and half-cent boundaries.

web/src/lib/admin/admin-shape.ts
web/src/lib/leaderboard/assemble-board.ts
web/src/lib/leaderboard/window-sums-batch.ts
web/test/leaderboard/micro-dollars.test.ts
</files>
